string.name: app_name
string.description: Application name displayed in the Android system launcher, recent apps switcher, and window title bar. [CHAR_LIMIT=20]

string.name: quick_access_section
string.description: Section header in the left navigation sidebar above Recents and Starred items. [CHAR_LIMIT=25]

string.name: pinned_section
string.description: Section header in the left navigation sidebar above user-pinned folders. [CHAR_LIMIT=20]

string.name: locations_section
string.description: Section header in the left navigation sidebar above local storage volumes and connected devices. [CHAR_LIMIT=25]

string.name: google_drive_section
string.description: Section header in the left navigation sidebar above signed-in Google Drive accounts. [CHAR_LIMIT=25]

string.name: network_and_cloud_section
string.description: Section header in the left navigation sidebar above SMB, WebDAV, FTP, and cloud mounts. [CHAR_LIMIT=30]

string.name: color_tags_section
string.description: Section header in the left navigation sidebar above color tag filter rows. [CHAR_LIMIT=25]

string.name: nav_recents
string.description: Navigation item label in the sidebar and breadcrumb bar for recently modified files. [CHAR_LIMIT=20]

string.name: nav_starred
string.description: Navigation item label in the sidebar and breadcrumb bar for user-starred files and folders. [CHAR_LIMIT=20]

string.name: nav_trash
string.description: Navigation item label in the sidebar and breadcrumb bar for the Trash bin. [CHAR_LIMIT=20]

string.name: search_files_placeholder
string.description: Placeholder hint text inside the top toolbar search input field when empty. [CHAR_LIMIT=25]

string.name: sort_button_label
string.description: Button label in the top toolbar that opens the file sorting menu (verb/noun action to sort files). [CHAR_LIMIT=15]

string.name: details_pane_title
string.description: Header title at the top of the right-hand file details and preview pane. [CHAR_LIMIT=20]

string.name: item_count_plural
string.description: Status bar and properties dialog item count summary. {0} is the number of files/folders (e.g. 1, 42). [CHAR_LIMIT=30] applies across all plural branch variants.

string.name: selected_count_plural
string.description: Status bar and preview pane summary of currently selected items. {0} is the number of selected items (e.g. 1, 12). [CHAR_LIMIT=35] applies across all plural branch variants.

string.name: search_result_count_plural
string.description: Search filter bar count of matching files found. {0} is the number of matching results (e.g. 1, 150). [CHAR_LIMIT=30] applies across all plural branch variants.
